jobs.title: Vice President, Information Technology and Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
About our Client:
Build Canada Homes (BCH) is Canada’s federal housing agency with the mandate to scale up the supply of affordable housing across the country. By leveraging public lands, deploying flexible financial tools, and acting as a catalyst for modern methods of construction, BCH is helping drive a more productive and innovative homebuilding sector. Working in partnership with non-profits, Indigenous organizations, private developers, and all orders of government, BCH is accelerating the delivery of housing Canadians need—faster, smarter, and more affordably.

Their priorities

Leverage public lands and mobilize capital to increase housing supply.
Accelerate large-scale affordable housing projects through partnerships.
Advance modern methods of construction to boost productivity and lower costs.

Following Royal Assent of the Build Canada Homes Act in June 2026, BCH is in a formative stage of transition toward a Crown Corporation. This creates a meaningful opportunity to help establish the governance, accountability, legal, risk, and corporate foundations of a national mission-driven organization with significant scale, visibility, complexity, and public trust responsibilities.

This role is offers a hybrid model. They currently work 2-3 days in office and potentially 4 days in the future.

Position Scope:
The VP, IT and Cybersecurity role, Information Technology (“IT”) leads the strategic direction, governance, and delivery of technology services across Build Canada Homes and its subsidiaries (collectively, the “Corporation” or “BCH”). The role is accountable for technology strategy, enterprise applications, IT operations and infrastructure, cybersecurity, technology risk management, and data governance capabilities that enable BCH to achieve its mandate through secure, reliable, and scalable technology services.

Working across BCH and with internal employees, technology vendors, service providers, and external stakeholders, the VP, IT and Cybersecurity, role ensures technology investments, digital capabilities, and information assets support operational execution, organizational performance, and long-term business priorities. The role establishes technology service delivery frameworks, digital enablement strategies, and governance practices that improve efficiency, innovation, collaboration, and user experience across the Corporation.

The VP, IT and Cybersecurity role provides leadership across IT operations and infrastructure, cybersecurity and technology risk, and data governance, management, and security. The role establishes functional policies, standards, oversight mechanisms, and performance frameworks consistent with the expectations of a Crown corporation, ensuring technology services remain secure, compliant, resilient, reliable and aligned with BCH priorities.

Responsibilities:

TECHNOLOGY STRATEGY, DIGITAL ENABLEMENT AND INNOVATION

Establishes the technology vision, priorities, and multi-year roadmap required to support BCH's mandate, business objectives, and operational requirements.
Aligns technology strategy, investments, and service delivery with organizational priorities and emerging business needs.
Leads or supports, where applicable, digital enablement and technology modernization initiatives that improve organizational effectiveness, scalability, and service delivery.
Identifies opportunities to leverage technology, automation, and innovation to enhance business performance and employee experience.
Provides strategic advice and guidance regarding technology trends, opportunities, risks, and investment priorities.

IT OPERATIONS AND INFRASTRUCTURE

Provides strategic oversight of enterprise applications, platforms, networks, cloud services, workplace technologies, and IT infrastructure.
Establishes service delivery models, operating standards, and performance expectations that support reliable, secure, and efficient technology operations.
Ensures technology services and infrastructure are scalable, resilient, and aligned with business continuity requirements.
Oversees technology lifecycle planning, system availability, capacity management, and service modernization activities.
Monitors technology performance and service outcomes and drives continuous improvement across technology operations.

CYBERSECURITY AND TECHNOLOGY RISK MANAGEMENT

Establishes cybersecurity strategies, policies, frameworks, and controls to protect BCH information assets, systems, and technology environments.
Leads the identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of cybersecurity and technology-related risks.
Oversees IT incident preparedness, response, recovery, and resilience programs to strengthen BCH's security posture.
Ensures compliance with applicable security, privacy, regulatory, and corporate requirements.
Provides strategic oversight of technology risk management practices and promotes security awareness throughout BCH.

DATA GOVERNANCE, MANAGEMENT AND SECURITY

Leads the development and implementation of data governance frameworks, standards, and accountabilities across BCH.
Establishes policies and practices that support data quality, stewardship, integrity, accessibility, and appropriate use of information assets.
Oversees data management, information security, retention, and protection practices in accordance with legislative and corporate requirements.
Enables the effective use of data and information to support reporting, analysis, planning, and decision-making.
Promotes a culture of responsible data management and information governance across BCH.

GOVERNANCE, PERFORMANCE AND LEADERSHIP

Provides leadership, direction, and oversight to Information Technology personnel, programs, and service delivery activities.
Establishes technology policies, standards, governance frameworks, and performance measures that support organizational objectives and regulatory compliance.
Leads technology planning, investment prioritization, resource allocation, and budget management activities.
Oversees technology vendor relationships, contracts, service agreements, and third-party performance management practices.
Establishes or supports, where applicable, reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance indicators to support executive decision-making and functional accountability.
Ensures technology programs, systems, and information assets are managed in accordance with BCH governance and risk requirements.
Promotes continuous improvement, service excellence, innovation, and operational effectiveness across the Information Technology function.
Supports the development of BCH's annual operating plans, strategic plans, and multi-year business priorities.
Contributes to enterprise planning, performance management, and organizational reporting activities.
Establishes and manages Information Technology budgets and resource plans.

Qualifications and Experience:

Post-secondary degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CGEIT, ITIL, PMP, TOGAF, Cloud certifications, or equivalent are considered assets.
Extensive experience of a minimum of ten to fifteen years in progressively senior technology leadership roles.
Proven track record leading enterprise technology, infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital transformation, and data governance functions within complex organizations, public-sector entities, Crown corporations, or similarly regulated environments.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategies aligned with business priorities.
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, technology risk management, enterprise architecture, IT operations, cloud technologies, and data governance practices.
Experience overseeing technology vendors, managed services, contracts, and strategic partnerships.
Demonstrated experience advising executive leaders on technology investments, digital enablement, cybersecurity, and information management matters.
Experience managing budgets, resources, and technology performance measures.
Occasional travel required (up to 20% of the time).
Bilingualism (English and French) is a strong asset.

AI Disclosure:
AI will not be used in the recruitment process.

Vacancy Disclosure:
This is a newly created position.

Application instructions:
To apply, please send a resume to Aman Sodi at Aman.Sodi@summitsearchgroup.com

Summit Search Group is a fair and equitable search firm. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process.

jobs.title: Director, Platform Delivery
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Director, Platform Delivery

The Director, Platform Delivery is accountable for the delivery performance, capability, effectiveness and long-term sustainability of HR technology teams responsible for building, enhancing and evolving HR technology solutions. The role ensures teams have the capacity, talent, skills, leadership, structure and ways of working required to translate priorities and technical direction into high-quality business outcomes for employees, managers and HR partners. Working through a shared leadership model, the Director partners across Product Management, Technology Enablement and Strategy, Agile Delivery Leadership and HR Technology Operations to strengthen delivery effectiveness, develop people, build organizational capability and ensure assigned teams can successfully deliver agreed business outcomes.

What will you do?

Be accountable for the overall delivery performance, capability, effectiveness and sustainability of assigned teams.
Ensure teams consistently translate agreed priorities and technical direction into high-quality delivered outcomes with the appropriate capacity, skills, leadership and team structures in place.
Partner with Agile Delivery Leads to strengthen flow, planning, predictability, agile maturity and delivery effectiveness.
Use delivery evidence, team insights and performance trends to identify constraints, capability gaps and opportunities for improvement.
Build resilient, collaborative and effective teams with clear expectations for roles, decision making, collaboration, accountability and outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop Senior Analysts, Analysts and other delivery professionals; provide ongoing coaching, candid feedback, performance leadership, development planning and career guidance.
Lead workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, performance and talent development; identify capability or capacity gaps and create practical plans to address them.
Help individuals and teams adopt new technologies, roles, ways of working and organizational models while maintaining focus on delivery outcomes.
Partner across Product Management, Agile Delivery, Technical Strategy and Enablement, and HR Technology Operations to ensure the right people, capabilities, leadership and team structures are in place to achieve agreed outcomes.

What you’ll need to succeed?

Significant experience leading technology, digital, platform or enterprise solution delivery teams.
Demonstrated success improving delivery performance, team effectiveness and business outcomes in a complex organization.
Experience ensuring teams have the capacity, skills, structures and leadership needed to meet commitments and adapt to changing priorities.
Experience working within agile or product-oriented operating models and partnering effectively across Product, Technology, Delivery and Operations leadership.
Demonstrated success building healthy, high-performing teams and strengthening leadership capability.
Strong experience leading and developing people, providing feedback and supporting meaningful career growth.
Experience leading workforce planning, talent development, succession, recruitment and organizational capability building.
Experience leading teams through transformation, organizational change and new ways of working.
Experience using evidence and performance insights to identify delivery constraints and guide improvement.
Experience with enterprise HR technology or comparable business platforms is an asset.
Knowledge and capabilities in technology and platform delivery leadership; delivery performance, capacity and capability management; agile and product-oriented ways of working; high-performing team leadership; people leadership, coaching and performance enablement; workforce, talent and succession planning; organizational design and capability building; change leadership and adaptability; stakeholder partnership and influence; systems thinking, evidence-based improvement and continuous learning.

What’s in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
Time off that allows you to focus on the moments that matter most. 20 vacation days per year.
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.
Working together, sharing common values, and encouraging growth & achievement.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Salary Range:

135,000/135 000 - 195,000/195 000

Job Category:

Human Resources

21/10/2026

jobs.title: Commercial Strategy / Pricing Lead - Global Software Leader
jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is a global software organisation, already recognised as a market leader, and set for significant growth. Its software is used by some of the world’s largest companies and it delivers award-winning, industry-changing solutions. As part of exciting plans, we are recruiting a strategic Commercial Lead to drive commercial operations and ensure alignment with business objectives.

You will be joining a winning team and have real opportunity to make a difference in a high-growth, successful global software company.

About the Role

The role will own pricing and commercial strategy for the company's SaaS solutions, playing a pivotal part in optimizing revenue streams, customer relationships, and operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product, finance, sales, and marketing to develop and execute strategies that support growth in a SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

Pricing and Strategy Ownership

Develop and maintain the price book, ensuring competitive and profitable pricing structures.
Lead overall pricing strategy, including analysis of market trends, competitor pricing, and customer value propositions.
Own the commercial strategy, aligning it with company goals and business needs.
Partner with product teams to inform pricing and commercial decisions based on feature development and roadmap.
Work with finance to analyze impacts of pricing models and commercial initiatives.
Collaborate with sales and marketing to align strategies, support deal structuring, and enhance go-to-market efforts.

Renewals and Compliance Management

Oversee renewals processes, including tracking, negotiation, and execution.
Ensure customer compliance with contracts, identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies.

Contract and Revenue Optimization

Lead contract structuring and negotiations for key deals, renewals, and amendments.
Implement tools and processes to track and enhance commercial performance metrics.

Market Analysis and Insights

Conduct in-depth market research to inform pricing models and commercial decisions.
Analyze competitor offerings, industry benchmarks, and economic factors impacting SaaS pricing.
Generate actionable insights from data to refine strategies and identify new revenue opportunities.

Requirements:

Proven experience in a SaaS business, with a strong track record in commercial strategy, pricing, and/or revenue operations.
Commercially astute with the ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make strategic recommendations.
Excellent collaboration skills, with experience working across product, finance, sales, and marketing teams.
Finance or accounting background is helpful, with familiarity in financial modelling and contract management.
5+ years of relevant experience in a similar role.

jobs.title: Director of Finance | Hotel PUR, Quebec, A Tribute Portfolio Hotel
jobs.description:
Discover Hotel PUR, Quebec, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, where bold design, local spirit and modern hospitality come together in the heart of Quebec City’s vibrant Saint-Roch district. With striking city views, distinctive spaces, locally inspired dining, a heated indoor pool and a neighborhood filled with art, culture, boutiques and celebrated restaurants, Hotel PUR offers guests an experience that is anything but ordinary. For hospitality professionals, it’s an opportunity to be part of a dynamic, design-forward property where the energy of Quebec City is woven into every guest experience.

The Director of Finance is responsible for providing ethical and consistent leadership in the financial area of the hotel by supplying management with guidance, training and support. The Director of Finance is also responsible for focusing on the profitability of the business, maintaining accurate and timely financial reporting, ensuring acceptable levels of internal controls, ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, and safeguarding owners/investors assets.

Responsibilities

Financial:

Acts as the “Chief Business Officer” to the general manager and EC Team, and as such is responsible for evaluating the financial impact on business decisions.
Ensure that all levels of management are promptly notified of any financial deviations from established policies and/or control weaknesses in the hotel.
Effectively manage and communicate cash flow related issues, as required to management and ownership. This includes the accurate and timely preparation of cash-flow statements, management of receivables, cash balances, control mechanisms and timely deposits of all funds.
Monitor hotel revenues and expenses and ensure the accurate recording in accordance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts established guidelines. Investigate and critique variances to budget or to prior year and offer practical improvement strategies to management.
Monitor the capital planning process by assisting management with calculation of return on capital improvements, gathering support and monitoring the bid process, and evaluating scope of work and specifications.
Ensure Hotels’ compliance on all regulatory licenses and permits, leases, contracts, legal agreements, and the proper execution of all operational taxes. Provide assistance to management in enforcing compliance on all these items.
Coordinate the completion of all forecasts and budgets as required, with the full and active participation of EC Team and department managers.
Analyze financial data and operations in order to assist and advise management in maintaining the Hotels’ financial objectives.
Ensure that all balance sheet accounts, including bank reconciliations are reconciled on a timely basis.
Establish and continually audit all internal financial controls including purchasing, cash handling, disbursements, credit extension, inventories, hotel assets, master keys, payroll, and employee records.
Embrace a continuous growth environment by actively hiring professional staff and assisting in recruiting, reviewing, recommending and maintaining an inventory of qualified and promotable Associates that can potentially become Directors of Finance, Assistant Directors of Finance, Accounting Managers, and other managers for the organization.
Continually focus on training and development programs for finance associates to cultivate the “brightest” and “best” talent within the industry.
Hire, train, supervise and develop staff, including coaching, counseling and discipline.
Maintain compliance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards and regulations to ensure safe and efficient operation of the hotel.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance and periodic upgrades of all IT systems and equipments.
Direct and/or prepare all financial reports in accordance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts requirements meeting various due dates and deadlines:
Ensure and monitor that the hotel is in compliance with all report deadlines and due dates and react accordingly.
Maximize efforts towards productivity, identify problem areas and assist in finding and implementing their solutions.
Approach all encounters with guests and employees in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service-oriented manner.
Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards, as required by scheduling which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.
Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which include wearing the professional attire and nametag when working.
Comply at all times with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.

QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education & Experience

A minimum of 8 years of related progressive experience in hotel Accounting or related field; or a 4-year college degree with an Accounting/Finance concentration and a minimum of 4 years of related progressive experience; or a 2-year college degree and a minimum of 6 years of related progressive experience.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

Director

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Hospitals and Health Care, Health and Human Services, and Mobile Computing Software Products
